title: Lower: Squat
warmup: Foam roll 2 min, then 2 rounds: Goblet Squat w/ Heartbeat × 8 · Inchworm Push-Up × 6 · CL Dead Bug × 6/side
jumps: Back Squat 2 @ RPE 7 → Box Jump 5 → DB Jump Squat 5 → Pogo Hops 10
Rest 10–20 sec between steps, 3:00 between rounds · every jump max intent
Quick off the floor, stiff ankles
strength: Slow, hold a rack or wall
note: New this week: trap bar is the Wednesday hinge, front squat is Thursday, and French contrast opens every lower day.
